result:
I ran every query against its input file and got a plausible answer for each, so I'm finishing now.

I spot-checked only a few of the answers against the data. W2 gives 199.87 and W8 gives 192. W7 counts errors per service only if the log has no blank lines. W11 would cut a value that itself contains "=". W13 would refuse a product with no `stock` key.

W1: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(query /address/city | ne null)) | filter ~(get /address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | map /name | sort
W2: filter ~(get /status | eq "paid") | map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
W3: filter ~(get /status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /customer | map ~(count)
W4: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map /0 | distinct | map ~(toString) | sort
W5: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | map ~(query /assignee/login "unassigned") | groupBy | map ~(count)
W6: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | map /labels | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
W7: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy /2 | map ~(count)
W8: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /2 | eq "api") | map ~(get /-1 | replace "took=" "" | replace "ms" "" | toNumber) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
W9: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | ne "") | map ~(get {:name /0 :dept /1 :s ~(get /2 | toNumber)}) | groupBy /dept | map ~(map /s | avg | round)
W10: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | ne "") | map ~(get {:name /0 :s ~(get /2 | toNumber | desc)}) | sort ~(get [/s /name]) | take 3 | map /name
W11: lines | filter ~(startsWith "db.") | map ~(split "=") | map ~(get [~(get /0 | replace "db." "") /1]) | toMap
W12: filter ~(get /type | eq "click") | map ~(query /payload/user/id) | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | count
W13: filter ~(allOf (get /stock | type | eq ::number) ~(get /stock | gt 0)) | map ~(get {:sku /sku :value ~(mulOf /price /stock | mul 100 | round | div 100)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /value | desc) /sku]) | take 3
W14: "alice@Example.com, Bob@example.com, carol@test.org, ALICE@example.com, dave@test.org, erin@Test.org, bob@EXAMPLE.com, frank@demo.net" | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | distinct | groupBy ~(split "@" | get /1) | map ~(count)
